actions.action: Merge drafts against their original revision
actions.mechanism: Compare the loaded baseline, local draft, and latest server document to distinguish independent edits from conflicts.
actions.implementation: Retain baseline values and revision. After stale-save rejection, carry forward one-sided changes; flag differing changes to the same field.
actions.check: Edits to separate fields survive without retyping; identical edits need no resolution; divergent edits are flagged.
actions.risk: Missing baseline data must trigger review, not guessed merges.

actions.action: Replace the warning with field-level resolution
actions.mechanism: An inline resolution screen isolates conflicting fields while preserving automatically combined edits elsewhere.
actions.implementation: Show baseline, this-tab, and saved values. Provide labeled single-choice selectors and editable text results; require explicit conflict confirmation.
actions.check: Users resolve every conflict in one tab without dragging or copying between windows; merged results remain unpublished.
actions.risk: Truncated previews can conceal differences; provide expandable complete values.

actions.action: Resolve long text at the changed passage
actions.mechanism: Three-way text comparison separates independent passage edits from overlapping changes within one field.
actions.implementation: Combine disjoint changes in a preview; show overlapping passages side by side with keep-either, keep-both, and edit controls. Retain originals.
actions.check: Separate-paragraph edits survive; overlapping deletions require review; keep-both inserts both passages without clipboard use.
actions.risk: Textually disjoint edits may conflict semantically; require preview confirmation.

actions.action: Preserve recoverable versions before replacing text
actions.mechanism: A recovery history makes text excluded during resolution retrievable rather than silently lost.
actions.implementation: Before applying resolutions, persist baseline, local, fetched, and resolved text snapshots. Expose restore-as-draft controls; block replacement if preservation fails.
actions.check: Reload after resolution and recover either original text in the same tab without changing published content.
actions.risk: Stored text needs access controls and an explicit retention policy.

actions.action: Recheck the revision when saving resolved drafts
actions.mechanism: Resolution uses conditional saving so another intervening save cannot be overwritten by an outdated merge.
actions.implementation: Submit the resolved draft against its fetched revision. On rejection, preserve it and repeat comparison using that fetched document as baseline.
actions.check: A third save during resolution causes another comparison, preserves reviewed edits, and never automatically publishes.
actions.risk: Repeated contention can require multiple review rounds; never force overwrite.

actions.action: Warn other tabs without replacing their drafts
actions.mechanism: Same-browser save notifications reveal stale tabs early while server revisions remain authoritative.
actions.implementation: Broadcast document ID and saved revision after successful saves. Show a nonblocking review banner in other tabs; never replace their text automatically.
actions.check: A dirty receiving tab retains its input. With notifications disabled or missed, stale-save rejection still invokes full resolution.
actions.risk: Notifications are advisory and may expose document identifiers locally.

actions.action: Test late edits in an already stale tab
actions.mechanism: Revision-based regression tests prevent last-edit timestamps from incorrectly determining which draft should win.
actions.implementation: Open two tabs at revision N. Save A, then edit stale B afterward and save B. Exercise text and single-choice conflicts.
actions.check: B is rejected as stale; both versions remain recoverable, independent edits survive, only conflicts require resolution, and nothing auto-publishes.
actions.risk: Timing-only tests are flaky; coordinate events with explicit barriers.
